turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_te_dopant_train.csv: 266 real samples, columns process/composition
    columns (Sb, Co, Fe) and `target` (the measured zT at 700 K among
    Skutterudite-based (doping/processing) variants).
  - b3_te_dopant_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE samples whose zT at 700 K among
    Skutterudite-based (doping/processing) variants was NOT measured,
    columns `candidate_id` and the same process/composition columns.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST zT at 700
K among Skutterudite-based (doping/processing) variants, then select the 5
best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
I compared pool candidates against the highest-performing regions in the training set, emphasizing local similarity because the response is highly composition-dependent and noisy. The strongest training clusters were:

- Sb≈0.587, Co≈0.396, Fe=0 with zT≈1.26–1.32
- Sb≈0.72, Co≈0.24, Fe=0 with zT up to ≈1.37
- Sb≈0.738, Co≈0.24, very small Fe with zT≈1.0–1.2
- Sb≈0.728–0.730, Co≈0.221–0.223, Fe≈0.022 with zT≈1.1–1.15

The best pool candidates are those lying closest to these high-zT neighborhoods. Ranked best first:

1. c023 — nearly identical to the high-zT Sb≈0.587/Co≈0.396 cluster  
2. c067 — very close to the top training point near Sb≈0.722/Co≈0.242/Fe=0  
3. c041 — in the same strong Sb≈0.718–0.722, Co≈0.239–0.243, Fe=0 region  
4. c053 — close to high-performing Sb≈0.738, Co≈0.24 with small Fe/Fe=0 compositions  
5. c001 — very close to high-zT low-Fe compositions around Sb≈0.728–0.730, Co≈0.221–0.223, Fe≈0.022  

Final: c023, c067, c041, c053, c001
